implemented: Added a bounded, read-only YAML mapping reader for nested maps, sequences, flow collections, quoted values, booleans, numbers and nulls.
Extended MarkdownProperty and the Markdown document read contract with typed values and explicit YAML issues while retaining raw source spans as the write authority.
Used typed nested Markdown values when building Bases rows and recursively rendered nested Base values without adding a DOM or Electron dependency to the core contract.
Kept unsupported literal/folded YAML blocks source-only and reported them instead of attempting an unsafe serializer or rewriting vault bytes.
limitations: This increment adds read fidelity only; structured YAML editing/serialization is intentionally not implemented, and unsupported YAML constructs remain source-only.
Reference Obsidian open-edit-save-reopen comparison, full YAML dialect coverage and cross-platform visible validation remain pending.
